journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics

articles.title_en: Immigration Lottery Design: Engineered and Coincidental Consequences of H-1B Reforms
articles.title_cn: 移民抽签设计：H-1B改革的工程化与巧合性后果
articles.abstract_en: The H-1B Visa Reform Act of 2004 dictates an annual allocation of 85,000 visas with 20,000 reserved for advanced-degree applicants. We represent the main requirements of this legislation as formal axioms and characterize visa allocation rules consistent with the axioms. Despite the precise number reserved, we show that the range of implementations satisfying these axioms can change the allocation of advanced-degree visas by as much as 14,000 in an average year. Of all rules satisfying these axioms, the 2019 rule imposed by executive order is most favorable to advanced-degree holders. However, two earlier modifications resulted in larger changes, possibly unintentionally.
articles.abstract_cn: 《2004年H-1B签证改革法案》规定每年分配85,000个签证，其中20,000个预留给高级学位申请人。我们将该立法的主要要求表示为形式化公理，并刻画符合这些公理的签证分配规则。尽管预留了精确的数量，我们表明满足这些公理的实施方案范围在平均年份中可使高级学位签证的分配变化多达14,000个。在所有满足这些公理的规则中，2019年通过行政命令实施的规则对高级学位持有者最为有利。然而，两次更早的修改导致了更大的变化，这可能是无意为之的。

articles.title_en: The Intellectual Spoils of War? Defense R&D, Productivity, and International Spillovers
articles.title_cn: 战争的知识战利品？国防研发、生产率与国际溢出效应
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impact of government funding for R&D—and defense-related R&D in particular—on privately conducted R&D and its ultimate effect on productivity growth. We estimate longitudinal models that relate privately funded R&D to lagged government-funded R&D using industry-country level data from OECD countries and firm level data from France. To deal with the potentially endogenous allocation of government R&D funds, we use changes in predicted defense R&D as an instrumental variable. In many OECD countries, expenditures for defense-related R&D represent by far the most important form of public subsidies for innovation. In both datasets, we uncover evidence of “crowding in” rather than “crowding out,” as increases in government-funded R&D for an industry or a firm result in significant increases in private sector R&D in that industry or firm. On average, a 10% increase in government-financed R&D generates a 5% to 6% additional increase in privately funded R&D. We also find evidence of international spillovers, as increases in government-funded R&D in a particular industry and country raise private R&D in the same industry in other countries. Finally, we find that increases in private R&D induced by increases in defense R&D result in productivity gains.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了政府研发资金——特别是国防相关研发——对私人研发的影响及其对生产率增长的最终效应。我们使用来自OECD国家的行业-国家层面数据和法国的企业层面数据，估计了将私人资助研发与滞后的政府资助研发联系起来的纵向模型。为了处理政府研发资金可能存在的内生性分配问题，我们使用预测的国防研发变化作为工具变量。在许多OECD国家，国防相关研发支出是公共创新补贴中迄今为止最重要的形式。在这两个数据集中，我们发现了“挤入”而非“挤出”的证据，因为政府资助研发的增加会导致该行业或企业的私人部门研发显著增加。平均而言，政府资助研发增加10%会带来私人资助研发额外增加5%至6%。我们还发现了国际溢出效应的证据，即特定行业和国家的政府资助研发增加会提高其他国家同行业的私人研发。最后，我们发现由国防研发增加所引致的私人研发增加会带来生产率收益。

articles.title_en: The Impact of Covid-19 on Productivity
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the impact of Covid-19 on productivity using data from an innovative monthly firm survey that asks for quantitative impacts of Covid-19 on inputs and outputs. We find that total factor productivity (TFP) fell by up to 6% during 2020–2021. The overall impact combined large reductions in ‘within-firm’ productivity, with offsetting positive ‘between-firm’ effects as less productive sectors, and less productive firms within them, contracted. Despite these large pandemic effects, firms’ post-Covid forecasts imply surprisingly little lasting impact on aggregate TFP. We also see significant heterogeneity over firms and sectors, with the greatest impacts in those requiring extensive in-person activity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一项创新性月度公司调查的数据分析了 Covid-19 对生产力的影响，该调查要求了解 Covid-19 对投入和产出的定量影响。我们发现，2020-2021期间全要素生产率（TFP）下降了6%。总体影响包括“公司内部”生产率的大幅下降，以及生产率较低的部门及其内部生产率较低的企业收缩所抵消的“公司间”积极影响。尽管有这些巨大的流行病影响，但令人惊讶的是，企业在新冠疫情后的预测表明，对总 TFP 的持久影响微乎其微。我们还看到不同公司和行业存在显着的异质性，其中影响最大的是那些需要大量面对面活动的行业。

articles.title_en: Racial Segregation in Housing Markets and the Erosion of Black Wealth
articles.title_cn: 住房市场中的种族隔离与黑人财富的侵蚀
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how the expansion of segregated neighborhoods eroded black wealth in prewar American cities. Using a novel sample of matched addresses, we find that over a single decade rental prices soared by roughly 50% on city blocks that transitioned from all white to majority black. Meanwhile, pioneering black families paid a 28% premium to buy a home on a majority white block, after which their homes lost 10% of their value. These findings strongly suggest that segregated housing markets cost black families much of the gains associated with moving north during the Great Migration.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了战前美国城市中隔离社区的扩张如何侵蚀了黑人财富。利用一个新颖的匹配地址样本，我们发现，在仅仅十年间，从全白人转变为黑人占多数的城市街区，租金价格飙升了约50%。与此同时，先驱黑人家庭在购买白人占多数的街区房屋时支付了28%的溢价，之后他们的房屋价值损失了10%。这些发现强烈表明，隔离的住房市场使黑人家庭失去了大迁徙期间北迁所获得的大部分收益。

articles.title_en: On the Economic Consequences of Mass Shootings
articles.title_cn: 论大规模枪击事件的经济后果
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the economic consequences of mass shootings. We find that shootings have negative effects on targeted counties’ economies. Estimates using three different comparison groups yield similar results. Examining the mechanisms, we find that residents of targeted areas: (i) develop pessimistic views of financial and local business conditions; and (ii) are more likely to report poor mental health, which hinders usual activities such as work, suggesting that shootings lead to decreases in productivity. Further, we find that greater national media coverage of shootings exacerbates their local economic consequences.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了大规模枪击事件的经济后果。我们发现枪击事件对目标县的经济有负面影响。使用三个不同比较组的估计结果相似。通过考察机制，我们发现目标地区的居民：（i）对金融和当地商业状况形成悲观看法；（ii）更可能报告心理健康状况不佳，这妨碍了如工作等日常活动，表明枪击事件导致生产力下降。此外，我们发现全国媒体对枪击事件的更多报道加剧了其当地经济后果。

articles.title_en: What Happens to Workers at Firms that Automate?
articles.title_cn: 企业自动化对工人有何影响？
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of firm-level automation on individual worker outcomes by combining Dutch microdata with a direct measure of automation expenditures covering all private nonfinancial sector firms. Using a novel difference-in-differences event-study design leveraging lumpy investment, we find that automation increases the probability of incumbent workers separating from their employers. Workers experience a five-year cumulative wage income loss of 9% of one year’s earnings, driven by decreases in days worked. These adverse impacts of automation are larger in smaller firms, and for older and middle-educated workers. By contrast, no such losses are found for firms’ investments in computers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过将荷兰微观数据与覆盖所有私营非金融部门企业的自动化支出直接度量相结合，估计了企业层面自动化对个体工人结果的影响。利用一种新颖的、基于块状投资的双重差分事件研究设计，我们发现自动化增加了在职工人与雇主分离的概率。工人经历五年累计工资收入损失，相当于一年收入的9%，这主要是由于工作天数减少所致。自动化的这些不利影响在较小企业中更为显著，且对年长和中等教育水平的工人影响更大。相比之下，企业在计算机上的投资并未发现此类损失。

articles.title_en: Deleting a Signal: Evidence from Pre-employment Credit Checks
articles.title_cn: 删除信号：来自雇佣前信用检查的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the removal of information from a market, such as a job-applicant screening tool. We characterize how removal harms groups with relative advantage in that information: typically those for whom the banned information is most precise relative to alternative signals. We illustrate this using recent bans on employers’ use of credit report data. Bans decrease job-finding rates for Black job-seekers by 3 percentage points and increase involuntary separations for Black new hires by 4 percentage points, primarily because other screening tools, such as interviews, have around 60% higher standard deviation of signal noise for Black relative to white job-seekers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了从市场中移除信息（如求职者筛选工具）的影响。我们刻画了这种移除如何损害在该信息上具有相对优势的群体：通常是那些被禁止的信息相对于替代信号对其更为精确的群体。我们利用近期对雇主使用信用报告数据的禁令来说明这一点。禁令使黑人求职者的就业率降低了3个百分点，并使黑人新员工的非自愿离职率增加了4个百分点，这主要是因为其他筛选工具（如面试）对黑人求职者的信号噪声标准差相对于白人求职者高出约60%。

articles.title_en: Do Export Support Programs Affect Prices, Quality, Markups, and Marginal Costs? Evidence From a Natural Policy Experiment
articles.title_cn: 出口支持计划是否影响价格、质量、加成率和边际成本？来自自然政策实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Firms’ success in international markets depends on their product’s quality, prices, markups, and marginal cost. However, causally identified empirical evidence for the effect of trade policies that address nontariff barriers on these mechanisms is rare. To fill this gap, we exploit a quasinatural experiment in Denmark and examine the effects of an export support policy aimed at reducing nontariff barriers to trade. We find that export support raises firm-level exports within markets. However, export support does not affect prices, quality, markups, or marginal costs. Instead, the results support trade theory predicting that firms grow in export markets by shifting demand.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业在国际市场上的成功取决于其产品的质量、价格、加成率和边际成本。然而，针对解决非关税壁垒的贸易政策对这些机制影响的因果识别经验证据却很少。为填补这一空白，我们利用丹麦的一项准自然实验，考察了一项旨在减少非关税贸易壁垒的出口支持政策的效果。我们发现，出口支持提高了企业在市场内的出口水平。然而，出口支持并不影响价格、质量、加成率或边际成本。相反，结果支持了贸易理论中关于企业通过转移需求在出口市场增长的预测。

articles.title_en: Getting the Price Right? The Impact of Competitive Bidding in the Medicare Program
articles.title_cn: 定价合理吗？医疗保险计划中竞争性招标的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study Medicare’s competitive bidding program for durable medical equipment. We use Medicare claims data to examine the effect on prices and utilization, focusing on continuous positive airway pressure devices for sleep apnea. We find that spending falls by 47.2% after a highly imperfect bidding mechanism is introduced. This is almost entirely driven by a 44.8% price reduction, though quantities also fall by 4.3%. To disentangle supply and demand, we leverage differential cost sharing across Medicare recipients. We measure a demand elasticity of -0.272 and find that quantity reductions are concentrated among less clinically appropriate groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了医疗保险对耐用医疗设备的竞争性招标计划。我们使用医疗保险索赔数据来检验其对价格和利用率的影响，重点关注睡眠呼吸暂停的持续气道正压通气设备。我们发现，在引入一个高度不完善的招标机制后，支出下降了47.2%。这几乎完全是由44.8%的价格下降驱动的，尽管数量也下降了4.3%。为了区分供给和需求，我们利用了医疗保险受益人间不同的成本分担。我们测得的需弹性为-0.272，并发现数量减少主要集中在临床适宜性较差的群体中。

articles.title_cn: 通过默认选项进行沟通
articles.abstract_en: We report the results of two laboratory experiments and a representative survey that investigate how default effects are shaped by information asymmetries and strategic incentives. We document that defaults are more informative when the interests of default setters and decision makers are more closely aligned. Decision makers’ propensity to accept defaults depends, both, on the alignment of interests and the quality of their information. In a second experiment, we demonstrate that decision makers are more likely to follow defaults than to accept (equally informative) advice. Complementary evidence from a representative survey underlines that consumers commonly perceive defaults as being set strategically.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们报告了两个实验室实验和一项代表性调查的结果，这些实验和调查研究了信息不对称和战略激励如何影响默认效应。我们记录到，当默认选项设置者和决策者的利益更加一致时，默认选项更具信息性。决策者接受默认选项的倾向既取决于利益的一致性，也取决于他们信息的质量。在第二个实验中，我们证明决策者更可能遵循默认选项，而不是接受（同样信息丰富的）建议。一项代表性调查的补充证据强调，消费者通常认为默认选项是战略性地设置的。

articles.title_en: Borrowing in an Illegal Market: Contracting with Loan Sharks
articles.title_cn: 非法市场中的借贷：与高利贷者的契约
articles.abstract_en: Using over 11,000 unlicensed loans to over 1,000 borrowers in Singapore, we provide basic information about an understudied market: illegal moneylending. Borrowers and lenders interact frequently and rely primarily on relational contracts to enforce their agreements. Borrowers have high discount rates, often have gambling and/or substance abuse problems, and often repay late. While lenders sometimes resort to nonfinancial punishments, the primary cost of late repayment is the compounding of a very high interest rate. Consistent with our view that lenders cannot extract all surplus, a crackdown on illegal lending raised interest rates and lowered the size of loans.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用新加坡超过11,000笔未注册贷款和超过1,000名借款人的数据，我们提供了关于一个研究不足的市场——非法放贷——的基本信息。借款人和放贷人频繁互动，主要依赖关系契约来执行他们的协议。借款人有较高的折现率，常常有赌博和/或药物滥用问题，并且经常逾期还款。虽然放贷人有时会诉诸非经济惩罚，但逾期还款的主要成本是极高利率的复利。与我们认为放贷人无法提取全部剩余的观点一致，对非法放贷的打击提高了利率并降低了贷款规模。

articles.title_en: What Is the Active Prevalence of COVID-19?
articles.abstract_en: We provide a method to track the active prevalence of COVID-19 in real time, correcting for time-varying sample selection in symptom-based testing data and incomplete tracking of recovered cases and fatalities. Our method only requires publicly available data on positive testing rates in combination with one parameter, which we estimate based on a representative randomized sample of nearly 10,000 individuals tested in Utah in May and June 2020. We validate our method using external studies in Indiana in April 2020 and two counties in Utah in March 2021. In all three locations and times, our estimates of latent prevalence are within the 95 percent confidence intervals of prevalence estimates from randomized testing. Applying our method to all 50 states, we show that true prevalence is 2–3 times higher than publicly reported.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一种实时追踪COVID-19活跃患病率的方法，该方法校正了基于症状检测数据中的时变样本选择问题，以及对康复病例和死亡病例追踪不完整的问题。我们的方法仅需要公开可得的阳性检测率数据，并结合一个参数，该参数我们基于2020年五月和六月在犹他州对近10,000人进行的代表性随机样本进行估计。我们使用2020年四月印第安纳州和2021年三月犹他州两个县的外部研究验证了我们的方法。在所有三个地点和时间点，我们对潜在患病率的估计均落在随机检测患病率估计的95%置信区间内。将我们的方法应用于所有50个州，我们发现真实患病率是公开报告数字的2-3倍。
